instruction.text: Izzy has baked 4 loaves of banana bread. Answer the questions below.

atoms.a: If she gives <mat>1/4</mat> of the loaves to her friend, how many loaves do they get?

instruction.text: Alex is eating a pizza cut into 8 slices. Answer the questions below.

atoms.a: Alex has eaten <mat>1/4</mat> of the pizza, how many slices has she eaten?
How many slices of pizza are still left?

instruction.text: Tom has baked 6 brownies. Answer the questions below.

atoms.a: If Tom eats <mat>1/3</mat> of the brownies, how many will he have eaten?

instruction.text: Ethan is giving away some of his marbles. He has 10 in total. Answer the questions below.

atoms.a: Ethan gives away <mat>1/2</mat> of his marbles, how many has he given away?
How many marbles does Ethan have left?
